items.information: 24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 – Астанадағы 24 сағаттық ашық жарыс. Бұл жарыстар 24 сағат үзіліссіз өтеді, сондықтан олар жас және жаңа қатысушыларға ұсынылмайды. Кез келген пәндер санына қатысу мүмкіндігімен базалық жарна 3000 теңгені құрайды. 1 кез келген пәнге тіркелу кезінде тіркеу жарнасы 1000 теңгені құрайды. Бұл жарыстарды QBERS TEAM ұйымдастырады. 24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 - это первые открытые 24-х часовые соревнования в Астане. Данные соревнования будут проходить без перерывов 24 часа, следовательно не рекомендуются для юных и новых участников. Базовый взнос с возможностью участия в любом количестве дисциплин составляет 3000 тенге. При регистрации на 1 любую дисциплину регистрационный взнос составит 1000 тенге. Данные сореванования организованы QBERS TEAM. 24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 is the first open 24-hour competition in Astana. These competitions will take place without breaks for 24 hours, therefore they are not recommended for young and new participants. The base registration fee for any number of events is 3000 tenge. If you're participating in 1 event only, the registration fee is 1000 tenge. These competition is organized by QBERS TEAM.

Puebla se prepara para recibirte en un torneo que pondrá a prueba tu nivel. **¿Estás listo para el desafío del 5x5?** El nombre del torneo no es coincidencia. El 5x5 representa un reto que exige estrategia, precisión y concentración. Así, el 5x5 se convierte en el corazón de este torneo, acompañado de otras categorías desafiantes. Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Juan Carlos Quiroz**. **555 - Puebla 2026** es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). ​ AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ ##### English ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Welcome to **555 - Puebla 2026**! Puebla is ready to welcome you to a tournament that will test your level. **Are you ready for the 5x5 challenge?** The name of the tournament is no coincidence. The 5x5 represents a challenge that requires strategy, precision, and focus. That’s why 5x5 becomes the heart of this tournament, accompanied by other challenging events. This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Juan Carlos Quiroz**. **555 - Puebla 2026** is an official WCA competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations). NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA3MjMyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--02d2cf755e400815ab55aabc2988d5378dd9e1c2/Divulga%C3%A7%C3%A3o%20AX%C3%89zinho.png) A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores menores de 16 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** Competitors under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children.

items.name: Aasee Algorithms 2023
items.information: Herzlich willkommen bei der allerersten Competition in Münster in der Geschichte der WCA! Wir laden euch ein zu einem Cubing-Wochenende mit einer bunten Mischung an Events direkt am Aasee. Spannung und Spaß sind garantiert und wir drücken euch die Daumen für viele persönliche Rekorde. Wir freuen uns gleichermaßen über neue und bekannte Gesichter - wenn du Spaß am Cuben hast, bist du hier genau richtig. Bis bald in Münster! Euer Orgateam Welcome to the very first competition in Münster in the history of the WCA! We invite you to a cubing weekend with a colorful mix of events directly at the lake Aasee. Excitement and fun are guaranteed and we keep our fingers crossed for many personal records. We are equally happy to welcome new and familiar faces - if you enjoy cubing, this is the right place for you. See you soon in Münster! Your organization team

items.name: Abierto del Mirador 2022
items.information: Bienvenidos al Abierto del Mirador 2022, nos complace traerles nuevamente un torneo a la Provincia de Buenos Aires. Nuestro evento contará con 10 categorías oficiales de la WCA distribuidas en 17 rondas. Solo se harán devoluciones del total del pago ($1000) a quienes estén en lista de espera una vez lleno el cupo de 60 competidores siempre y cuando se confirme que no asistirán al torneo antes del mismo, no se harán devoluciones luego del evento. Se aceptarán los registros por orden de llegada del e-mail correspondiente con comprobante a la casilla de correo del organizador. Pedimos que dentro de las posibilidades se atienda al torneo con un (1) acompañante por cuestiones de espacio físico en el lugar del torneo. Pedimos puntualidad a todos y recomendamos llegar al menos 15 minutos antes de cualquier categoría en la que el competidor vaya a participar. Welcome to Abierto del Mirador 2022, we are pleased to bring you again a tournament to the Province of Buenos Aires. Our competition will feature 10 official WCA events distributed in 17 rounds. Refunds of the total payment ($1000) will only be made to those who are on the waiting list once the quota of 60 competitors is filled as long as it is confirmed that they will not attend the tournament beforehand, no refunds will be made after the event. Registrations will be accepted on a first-come, first-served basis with proof of receipt to the organizer's e-mail address. We ask to attend, within the possibilities, with a maximum of one (1) companion for reasons of physical space at the tournament site. We ask for punctuality to all and recommend to arrive at least 15 minutes before any category in which the competitor will participate.

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Ajax 3x3x3 Series 2023 One day, three competitions! We are running three competitions as part of Ajax 3x3x3 Series 2023: [morning](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Morning2023), [afternoon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Afternoon2023) and [evening](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax333Evening2023)! You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these three competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** This is a great opportunity to compete in 3x3x3 Cube – the maximum-allowed top-75% of competitors will advance to the second round! ### Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Almaty Cubers Open 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0JnIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c2c573f7f7fdb35dfefadfdf1d622dbf8757cd30/Logo.jpg) **Russian** Almaty Cubers Open 2024 - это открытый чемпионат в городе Алматы. Базовый взнос с возможностью участия в 3-5 дисциплинах составляет 4000 тенге. Данные сореванования организованы командами Almaty Cubers и QBERS, при поддержке общественное объединение "Meyir-Zhan" **Қазақша** Almaty Cubers Open 2024 - бұл Алматы қаласындағы ашық чемпионат. 3-5 пәнге қатысу мүмкіндігімен бастапқы ақысы - 4000 теңге. Осы жарыс Almaty Cubers және QBERS құрамаларымен, MEYIR-ZHAN қоғамдық бірлестігінің қолдауымен. **English** Almaty Cubers Open 2024 is an open championship in the city of Almaty. The basic fee with the opportunity to participate in 3-5 disciplines is 4000 tenge. These competitions were organized by the Almaty Cubers and QBERS teams, with the support of the public association "Meyir-Zhan"

items.information: **Español:** NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19. Hay un límite de 30 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad, a nuevos y viejos competidores, sin importar los tiempos de resolución. * Por razones sanitarias, no estarán permitidos los acompañantes a menos que sea necesario y esté justificado debidamente (p.ej. menores de edad). Máximo un acompañante por persona. * La competencia funcionará de acuerdo a la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), por lo tanto es importante que la lean para evitar inconvenientes, además, se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA. * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles. * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la categoría, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. * Leer toda la información disponible en esta página. **¡Importante!** **La competencia puede ser cancelada por la Junta Directiva de la WCA si la situación de la pandemia empeora.** Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. **English:** YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF THE COVID-19. Competitor limit: 30. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * For safety reasons, guests won't be allowed inside the venue, unless a competitor requires a guest for any justified reason (e.g. minors). Only one guest per competitor allowed. * This competition will be held in accordance with the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue (see regulation [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3)). A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition (regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1)). Please read the WCA Safety Policy to avoid any issue. * Competitors must provide their own puzzles. * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with the article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. * Read all the information available in this website. **Attention!** **The competition may be canceled by the WCA Board if the pandemic situation gets worse.** For any question, feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcnlIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--332177ea99a8c8d5f8b82db10b1ac1f7c00234a9/io%20(1).png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al Ameca Nayarit 2025, la primera competencia oficial en el hermoso entorno costero y tropical de Nuevo Nayarit, y la segunda en el municipio de Bahía de Banderas! Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo los dias 18 y 19 de enero del 2025. A medida que el río fluye, también lo hará la emoción de ver a los competidores resolver el cubo Rubik con asombrosa rapidez. Prepárense para estas jornadas inolvidables llenas de ingenio y velocidad. Esta competencia es organizada por la comunidad de Vallarta Speed. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. ###### English Welcome to the Ameca Nayarit 2025, the first official competition in the beautiful coastal and tropical environment of Nuevo Nayarit, and the second in the municipality of Bahía de Banderas! This exciting and fast-paced event will take place on January 18 and 19, 2025. As the river flows, so will the thrill of watching competitors solve the Rubik's Cube with astonishing speed. Get ready for these unforgettable days full of ingenuity and speed. This competition is organized by the Vallarta Speed community. This competition is recognized as a World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. ### **IMPORTANT** You must check [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to understand the rules and procedures to be followed during the tournament. * Check [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AmericasSchoolIIHuaraz2024#44945-registro-registration) to know the registration method. * Check [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AmericasSchoolIIHuaraz2024#competition-schedule) to know the cronogram. * To **Register** to the competition click [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AmericasSchoolIIHuaraz2024/register) * We also recommend that you review this video to have a clearer notion of how the competition will be conducted. [WCA Competitor Tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) • * It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID.

items.information: #### **This is a very beginner-friendly competition! All are welcome but if you have never competed before this is the one to sign up for!** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjUwMzMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--2d81b584eaed41b3bca38d74ac30447709a1944e/NCM%202025%20A1.png) This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. ##### The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. There will be special prizes to honour first-timer cubers! Registrations will be accepted based on the following: 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. * Make sure you will be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. You WILL NOT be allowed to participate in an event if you reach late for the same. We urge all the competitors to strictly adhere to the rules and regulations to contribute to the mission of providing a comfortable ambience for all the fellow cubers. If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, make sure that you attend the tutorial session. Please bring your ID card as well. Happy cubing!

Irrespective of the events... Yes, Including 3x3 and other NxN events which don't generally demand silence. :) We aim to experiment and see how much more efficient we'd all be in an ambience more favorable for cubing. With minimal spectator pressure. We plan have separate rooms for waiting and competing, where the competing area would only have the competitors for the round, scramblers, and judges in it. items.information: There are two competitions being held in Central Square at St. Mary Orthodox Church on June 1st: this competition, An Afternoon in Central Square 2024, in the afternoon, and A Morning in Central Square 2024 in the morning. **These are not series competitions. You may sign up for either or both.** A Morning in Central Square will have 3x3, 2x2, and pyraminx. An Afternoon in Central Square will have Square-1, 5x5, Clock, and 3x3 Blindfolded. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthamptonNewcomersA2024#38747-competitor-information) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years of age.

venue.name: Escola Básica Aníbal César
venue.address: R. Estefano José Vanolli 941- São Vicente, Itajaí - SC, 88309-201

items.information: Bem-vindos ao Aníbal ao Cubo 2026! A Escola Aníbal Cesar começou a história do Cubo Mágico na cidade de itajaí, e com satisfação recebe o seu 3º campeonato oficial! Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba Inscrever. Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste vídeo.https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8 Favor ler o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição. Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para novatos na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'. A premiação extra-oficial será feita de acordo com a classificação do competidor na competição. (não será definida pela primeira rodada) ATENÇÃO! Informamos que o cronograma pode ser adiantado ao longo do dia, por isso esteja no local para competir pelo menos 30 minutos antes da sua modalidade começar. ⚠️ Inscrições no local serão aceitas exclusivamente para a modalidade 3x3x3. 🇺🇸 Welcome to Aníbal ao Cubo 2026! Aníbal Cesar School started the Rubik’s Cube scene in the city of Itajaí and is pleased to host its 3rd official competition! Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance — more information in the “Register” tab. If you have difficulties registering, see how to do it in this video: https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8 Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition. We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for women and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event. The unofficial awards will be given according to the competitor's position in the competition (It will not be based on the first round results.) ATTENTION! Please note that the schedule may be brought forward throughout the day, so make sure to be at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. ⚠️ On-site registration will be accepted only for the 3x3x3 event.

items.information: ##Português **Atenção:** Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar**. Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com a organização**. Pagamento da taxa via PIX: matcasvia@gmail.com Enviar comprovante para o e-mail: matcasvia@gmail.com Envie o comprovante com o nome do competidor. Sócios do Clube Aquático da Aclimação terão 50% de desconto na inscrição e terão de informar no campo de comentários que são sócios e comprovar no dia da competição. Para inscrições no local, favor levar documento que comprove sua identidade. **Aviso**: Ao se inscrever para a competição, você automaticamente se disponibiliza para atuar como juiz, runner e/ou embaralhador quando solicitado. A recusa não justificada poderá acarretar em desclaificação (DNF) de um ou mais eventos de acordo com a regra [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2). ##English **Attention:** This competition will have a limit of competitors. Sign up only if you are **sure you will attend**. In case of withdrawal, please **contact the organization**. Payment with PIX method: matcasvia@gmail.com Send the payment proof to E-mail: matcasvia@gmail.com Send the proof with the competitor's name. Members of the Aclimação Aquatic Club will have a 50% discount on registration and will have to inform in the comments field that they are members and prove it on the day of the competition. To register on site, please bring a document that proves your identity. **Warning:** By registering for the competition, you automatically make yourself available to act as a judge, runner and/or scrambler when requested. Unjustified refusal may result in disqualification (DNF) of one or more events according to rule [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2).

En el corazón de la ciudad más grande de latinoamerica, Aragon Treasure presentará uno de los desafíos más grandes en la historia del speedcubing mexicano, ¿estás listo? *Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.* **Esta es una competencia gratuita, al registrarte aceptas cumplir con las actividades de staff que te serán asignadas**. Welcome to the first WCA competition hosted by [Team CDMX ](https://www.facebook.com/TEAMCDMX)and [Team Querétaro](https://www.facebook.com/teamrubikqro). **Aragon Treasure is a free competition thanks to [Brick Cubes](https://www.facebook.com/BrickCubes) sponsorship**. In the guts of Latin America's largest city, Aragon Treasure will present one of the biggest challenges in the history of Mexican speedcubing. Are you ready? *This competition is recognized as World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiarized with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)* **This is a free competition, by registering, you agree to perform all staff tasks assigned to you**.

items.information: **Português** Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas; - Taxas de inscrição não serão devolvidas em nenhuma circunstância; - Não serão aceitas inscrições no local; - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition 30 minutes before the event you will participate in; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubers; - Registration fees will not be refunded under any circumstances; - Registrations will not be accepted at the competition venue; - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.information: Argentina ReOpen 2021 es el primer torneo en el país luego del comienzo de la pandemia mundial. Este contará con 12 categorias y 21 rondas en total. El objetivo es que los competidores puedan volcar todo su avance durante la cuarentena y reactivar las competencias en todo el país. Contamos con la experiencia de haber organizado el primer torneo en la zona (Patagonia Open 2019) con gran éxito. Se ruega mucha puntualidad. Recomendamos llegar 15 minutos antes de cada prueba en la que compitas. Argentina ReOpen 2021 is the first tournament in the country since the start of the global pandemic. It will have 12 events and 21 rounds in total. Our goal is to let the competitors show their progress during the lockdown and to reactivate the competitions all over the country. We have the experience of having organized the first tournament on the region (Patagonia Open 2019) with great success. Please be very punctual. We recommend that you arrive 15 minutes in advance for each event you compete in.

items.name: Arkadia 2022
items.information: "Arkadia 2022" será la tercera competencia del año en el país. Se tendrán protocolos de bioseguridad por pandemia y los requeridos por la WCA, para permitir la realización de competencias con el mejor ambiente posible. Deberá usarse mascarilla todo el tiempo, habrá alcohol en gel y se tomará la temperatura al registrarse. Se aceptará como máximo un acompañante por competidor. "Arkadia 2022" will be the third competition in the country this year. There will be biosecurity protocols due to the pandemia, and those required by the WCA as well, to allow a good environment while holding competitions. Use of face mask is mandatory all day, also there will be gel alcohol and temperature will be measured at the entrance. A maximum of one guest will be allowed for each competitor.

items.information: # REGISTRO/REGISTRATION Portuguese A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Tomar todos os cuidados referente ao COVID-19 e seguir o que será indicado pelo delegado e organizador da competição; 2. Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial; 3. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; 4. Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 15,00 pagos antecipadamente por meio de depósito bancário ou pix. Não serão aceitas inscrições no dia do campeonato. Conta para deposito: Banco Itau | Ag. 7021 | CC 05400-7 -> Pix 103552998-01. 5. Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (antonio.cecchini@gmail.com), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (emattos@worldcubeassociation.org). O acesso ao local será permitido mediante comprovação de esquema vacinal completo, ou teste negativo para Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no local, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento (para o competidor e o acompanhante). Para as crianças menores de 12 anos, será solicitado o teste negativo de Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do acesso ao local. Essas regras podem ser mais restritas ou flexibilizadas conforme orientações dos órgãos governamentais até a data do evento. _______ English The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Take all precautions regarding COVID-19 and follow what will be indicated by the delegate and the organizer; 2. Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition; 3. Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind. 4. Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$15 paid in advance by bank transfer or Pix. Registration at competition day will not be allowed. Bank Account: Itau Bank | Ag. 7021 | CC 05400-7 -> Pix 103552998-01. 5. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (antonio.cecchini@gmail.com), or the delegate via email (emattos@worldcubeassociation.org). Access to the venue will be allowed upon proof of the complete vaccination schedule, or a negative test for Covid-19 of the PCR type, took up to 48 hours before entering the venue, or of the antigen type, took up to 24 hours before entry into the establishment (for both competitor and companion). For children under 12 years of age, a negative Covid-19 PCR test will be required, took within 48 hours before entering the establishment, or an antigen test took within 24 hours before entering the venue. These rules may be changed to be more restrictive or flexible based upon governmental mandates until the event date.

items.information: AVISO: Si eres nuevo, recomendamos acudir a una ['competición normal'](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AmoreOpen2023) antes. Este open será un test para competiciones similares, en las que cada competidor realizará medias en los eventos que quiera en el orden que quiera. Para participar, a parte de registrarse en le WCA, es necesario rellenar el [siguiente formulario](https://forms.gle/iWCecxy5zJgC5bv66), y asistir a los dos grupos, de inicio a fin. Más información en la pestaña de FUNCIONAMIENTO DE LA COMPETICIÓN. OHARRA: Zure lehen lehiaketa bada, aurretik ['lehiaketa arrunt'](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AmoreOpen2023) batera joatea gomendatzen dizugu. Open hau antzeko lehiaketetarako test bat izango da, lehiakide bakoitzak nahi dituen ekitaldietako batez bestekoak egingo ditu nahi duen ordenan. Parte hartzeko ezinbestekoa da [formulario hau](https://forms.gle/iWCecxy5zJgC5bv66) betetzea, eta bi taldeetan egon, hasieratik amaierara. Informazio gehiago LEHIAKETAREN FUNTZIONAMENDUA erlaitzean. WARNING: If you're a new competitor, we recommend you attend a ['normal' competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AmoreOpen2023) first. This competition will be a test, in which each competitor will do their averages in the order they want. To participate at this competition, it is mandatory to fill out [this form](https://forms.gle/iWCecxy5zJgC5bv66), and also attend both groups. More information at the HOW WILL THE COMPETITION WORK tab. ![Imgur](https://imgur.com/IGPQ5Rf.jpg)

Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1 неделю до и непосредственно перед закрытием регистрации вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Обязательно проверяйте свой ящик и папку СПАМ. Если вы не оплатите взнос, то Ваша заявка не будет принята. Если Вы подали заявку и оплатили взнос, но в течении 2-х рабочих дней ее не подтвердили, сразу обратитесь к организаторам (не считая выходные дни). ##### В день соревнований участнику при себе нужно иметь документ удостоверяющий личность. --- Біздің Instagram парақшамызды қараңыз (https://instagram.com/speedcubing_ksf?utm_medium=copy_link). Байқау туралы барлық ақпарат пен жаңалықтар біздің instagram желісінде болады. 1.Жеке заттар жоғалуына ұйымдастырушылар жауапты емес. Пазлдарда ерекше белгілерді пайдалануды ұсынамыз (текшенің ішінде немесе бөліктің мұқабасының астында), белгі арқылы иесі оларды оңай анықтауға мүмкіндік береді. Төлемді төлегеннен кейін сіздің аты-жөніңіз сайтта пайда болады. Бұл сіздің өтінішіңіз қабылданғанын білдіреді. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемеген болсаңыз, онда тіркеуден шамамен 1 апта бұрын және тіркеуді жаппас бұрын, сіз өзіңіздің қатысуыңызды растау үшін жарнаны төлеу қажеттілігі туралы ескерту хат аласыз. Міндетті түрде Жәшік пен СПАМ қалтасын тексеріңіз. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемесеңіз, онда сіздің өтініміңіз қабылданбайды. Егер сіз өтінім беріп, жарнаны төлеген болсаңыз, бірақ оны 2 жұмыс күні ішінде растамаған болса, дереу Ұйымдастырушыларға хабарласыңыз (демалыс күндерін есептемегенде). ##### Жарыс күні қатысушыда өзімен бірге жеке басын куәландыратын құжат болуы қажет. --- Please see our Instagram account (https://www.instagram.com/cubing.kz?igsh=MTlycGkxYnd5MnF6aA==). All information and news on the competition will be on our instagram. The organizers are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings. We strongly recommend using distinctive marks on the puzzles (Inside the cube or under the cover of the part), by which the owner can easily identify them. After paying the fee, your name will appear on the site. This means that your application has been accepted. If you have not paid the fee, you will receive an email reminding you to pay the fee to confirm your participation approximately 1 week before and immediately before the registration closes. Be sure to check your inbox and SPAM folder. If you do not pay the fee, your application will not be accepted. If you submitted an application and paid the fee, but did not confirm it within 2 working days, immediately contact the organizers (excluding weekends). ##### On the day of the competition, the participant must have an identity document with him.

items.name: Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0ppIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7074cb88987f8a1665e68652fe09ce8f6b104f3b/image.png) Ξεκινά η συναρπαστική σειρά των διαγωνισμών για το 2024 με το 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024', τον πρώτο διαγωνισμό της χρονιάς, αφιερωμένο στους νέους λάτρεις του cubing! Με μεγάλη χαρά και ενθουσιασμό ανοίγουμε την αυλαία για μια σειρά από διαγωνισμούς, όπου νέοι συμμετέχοντες θα έχουν την ευκαιρία να αναδείξουν το ταλέντο και την αγάπη τους για το cubing. Το 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024' θα είναι μια πρώτη ευκαιρία για τους νέους cubers να γευτούν την μαγεία του ανταγωνισμού και να γνωρίσουν την κοινότητα από κοντά. Μην χάσετε την ευκαιρία να γίνετε μέρος αυτής της μοναδικής εμπειρίας. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε για την πρόκληση και ελάτε να γιορτάσουμε μαζί το πάθος για το cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) The exciting series of competitions for 2024 begins with the 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024', the first competition of the year, dedicated to new "cubing enthusiasts"! With great joy and excitement, we open the curtain on a series of competitions where new participants will have the opportunity to showcase their talent and love for cubing. The 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024' will be a first chance for them to taste the magic of competition and get to know the community up close. Don't miss the chance to be a part of this unique experience. Grab your cubes, get ready for the challenge and come celebrate the passion for cubing together! Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: **Αυτός ο διαγωνισμός απευθύνεται σε άτομα που συμμετέχουν για πρώτη φορά και σε λιγότερο έμπειρους διαγωνιζόμενους, αλλά όλοι είναι ευπρόσδεκτοι. Παρόλο που ο διαγωνισμός είναι ανοικτός σε όλους, μόνο οι διαγωνιζόμενοι που έχουν συμμετάσχει σε 3 ή λιγότερους διαγωνισμούς στο παρελθόν θα έχουν δικαίωμα για μετάλλια.** **This competition is targeted at first-time participants and less experienced competitors, but everyone is welcome. Even though the competition is open to everyone, only competitors who have participated in 3 or fewer competitions in the past will be eligible for medals.** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTgyNDIyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2a933401125a79a3d07562b86d1bb5f492a5862a/image.png) Ο διαγωνισμός **WCA SUMMER BREAK ATHENS 2026 Β (14/6)** έρχεται για να φέρει το καλοκαίρι… στα πιο γρήγορα solves! 🌞🧊 Πρόκειται για έναν φιλικό και ανοιχτό διαγωνισμό speedcubing στην Αθήνα, σχεδιασμένο με έμφαση στους **αρχάριους**, αλλά χωρίς κανέναν περιορισμό συμμετοχής για όλους τους Cubers. Είτε κάνεις τα πρώτα σου βήματα είτε έχεις ήδη εμπειρία, μπορείς να δηλώσεις συμμετοχή και να ζήσεις την εμπειρία ενός επίσημου WCA διαγωνισμού μέσα σε ένα χαλαρό και υποστηρικτικό περιβάλλον. Η ιδιαιτερότητα του διαγωνισμού είναι ότι **τα podium θα είναι αφιερωμένα στους νέους cubers**. Ετσι, όσοι έχουν ολοκληρώσει έως και 3 επίσημους διαγωνισμούς μέχρι την εγγραφή τους θα διεκδικήσουν τις θέσεις των μεταλλίων. Με αυτό τον τρόπο, δίνεται η ευκαιρία στους αρχάριους να ξεχωρίσουν και να απολαύσουν τη χαρά της διάκρισης, ενώ όλοι οι υπόλοιποι συμμετέχοντες μπορούν να αγωνιστούν κανονικά και να απολαύσουν τη διοργάνωση. **Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το **Β μέρος** σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **ΜΟΝΟ σε έναν από τους δύο**. Αγωνίσματα B' διαγωνισμού: * 2x2 * 3x3 * 4x4 * Pyraminx Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) **The WCA SUMMER BREAK ATHENS 2026 B (June 14th)** is coming to bring the summer vibes... to the fastest solves! 🌞🧊 This is a friendly and open speedcubing competition in Athens, designed with an emphasis on **beginners**, but without any participation restrictions for any cubers. Whether you are taking your first steps or already have experience, you can register and live the experience of an official WCA competition within a relaxed and supportive environment. The unique feature of this competition is that **the podiums will be dedicated to new cubers**. Specifically, only those who have completed up to 3 official competitions by the time of their registration will be eligible for medals. This gives beginners a chance to stand out and enjoy the thrill of winning, while all other participants can compete as usual and enjoy the event. Note: This competition is **Part B** of a two-competition series. You may participate in **ONLY one of the two**. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0Y5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--cb6d356bf5594b0c88d80b79f9ce71c51f373a9e/5adbd2ae-6772-4ce6-9aab-d590f0ad777b.jpg) To Athens TableTop Open 2024 είναι ο 6ος διαγωνισμός της WCA στην Ελλάδα για το 2024. Ο διαγωνισμός γίνεται στις 7 Ιουλίου 2024 στο κλειστό Ολυμπιακό γήπεδο του Τάεκβοντο στην Αθήνα στο Δέλτα Φαλήρου κατά την διάρκεια του Φεστιβάλ Επιτραπέζιων Παιχνιδιών [Athens Tabletop](https://www.tabletopcon.gr/). Το Athens TableTop Open 2024 τελεί υπό την αιγίδα της WCA και διοργανώνεται από το ηλεκτρονικό κατάστημα [GamesUniverse.gr](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/) , την [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) και την [V-Games](https://v-games.eu/), οι οποίες ανήκουν στην εταιρεία [Καινοτομίες Βερδέ ΑΕΒΕ](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/content/8-poioi-eimaste). Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε για μια μοναδική εμπειρία και γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τόσο την παρούσα σελίδα όσο και τις επόμενες σελίδες Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί **το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA KAI να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντίτιμου συμμετοχής όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα** . Επίσης, για την είσοδό σας στον χώρο θα χρειαστεί **ξεχωριστό εισιτήριο για την έκθεση** αξίας 8 ευρώ για μία μέρα ή 14 για το διήμερο, το οποίο σας παρέχει πρόσβαση σε όλο τον χώρο της έκθεσης, όπου μπορείτε να γνωρίσετε τόσο τα προϊόντα μας, όσο και πολλών ακόμα εκθετών. Εισιτήρια για το φεστιβάλ θα βρείτε εδώ [εδώ.](https://www.tabletopcon.gr/tickets2024/) [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RS768gK0Vrg&feature=youtu.be) Σημείωση Αποδοχής κινηματογράφησης ή φωτογράφισης. Οι διαγωνιζόμενοι και οι συμμετέχοντες με την συμμετοχή τους στο Athens TableTop Open 2024 αυτόματα συμφωνούν με την πιθανή χρήση των εικόνων τους από τους διοργανωτές σε προωθητικές ενέργειες, κοινωνικά δίκτυα και άλλες ψηφιακές ενέργειες. Οι online εγγραφές ανοίγουν στη 1η Ιουνίου 2024 και κλείνουν στις 30 Ιουνίου 2024. Athens Tabletop Open 2024 is the 6th WCA Competition in Greece during 2024. The competition is taking place on the 7th of July during the Festival of Board Games ["Athens Tabletop"](https://www.tabletopcon.gr/?lang=en), at the [Athens Tae Kwon Do Stadium](https://www.facebook.com/taekwondofaliro/), which is located in the Faliron Delta of Athens. Athens Tabletop Open 2024 is an official WCA competition and is co-organized from the e-shop [GamesUniverse.gr](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/) , [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) and [V-Games](https://v-games.eu/), all of which are subsidiaries of [Verdes innovations S.A](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/content/8-poioi-eimaste) . Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules and come for an unforgettable experience and celebration of cubing! Please read the following and the rest of the tabs very carefully. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should **both register though the WCA site AND pay the registration fee** as described in the adjacent tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information. Additionally, for entry to the venue, **a separate ticket for the exhibition is required,** costing 8 euros for one day or 14 euros for two days. This ticket provides access to the entire exhibition area, where you can explore both our products and those of many other exhibitors. items.name: Athens Winter Open 2023
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2N0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--83fc6c836b78e431cd8e0d013efd6be412a6e388/IMG_9500.JPG) Athens Winter Open 2023 είναι ο πρώτος διαγωνισμός για φέτος στην Ελλάδα , ύστερα από μία πολλά υποσχόμενη χρονιά. Στις επόμενες διοργανώσεις, θα εστιάζουμε πάντα σε 2 διοργανώσεις που δεν είναι ακόμα πολύ γνωστές στην Ελλάδα. Σε αυτό το διαγωνισμό θέλουμε να φέρουμε τα αγωνίσματα του 6x6 και του 7x7 πιο κοντά στους συμμετέχοντες. Ο στόχος είναι να διεξαχθεί το πρώτο ελληνικό εθνικό πρωτάθλημα προς το τέλος του τρέχοντος έτους. Μέχρι τότε, όλες οι εκδηλώσεις θα είναι οικείες στους συμμετέχοντες. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μία ακόμα γιορτή για το cubing γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλώ διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείτε ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registrations στο site της wca και να γίνει η πληρωμή της εισόδου, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Athens Winter Open 2023 is the first competition this year in Greece, following a very successfull year of competitions. In the next competitions, we will always focus on 2 events that are not yet very well known in Greece. In this competition we want to bring the events 6x6 and 7x7 closer to the competitors. The goal is to make the first Greek National Championship towards the end of this year. By then, all events will be familiar to the competitors. Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the eca site and pay the fee as described in the nexts tabs.

items.information: ![Speedcubing Austria Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTg3OTA4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--279a016a5545862ad7b5d27844f6185ca48fc68a/SpeedcubingAustria_Logo_comp_page.png) ***English version is below*** **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr die ersten Austrian Nationals ankündigen zu dürfen! Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Lukas Schwarz, Marcel Niedl, Noah Kirrane, Phillip Leimer, Simon Praschl und Thomas Strasser und delegiert von Fabian Staber, Florian Truckenthanner, Jeremia E. Neuhold, Pranjal Khan und Viktor Kalmar. Die Championship wird im Großen Saal und Turnsaal der Pfarre Akkonplatz stattfinden. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! **English:** We are happy to announce the first ever Austrian Nationals! The speedcubing competition is organised by Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Lukas Schwarz, Marcel Niedl, Noah Kirrane, Phillip Leimer, Simon Praschl and Thomas Strasser and delegated by Fabian Staber, Florian Truckenthanner, Jeremia E. Neuhold, Pranjal Khan and Viktor Kalmar. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.name: Austrian Open 2019
items.information: Autrian Open 2019 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other related puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. This competition is NOT a national championship for Austria.

items.name: Autotalo All Events 2023

venue.name: Autotalo
venue.details: Salomonkatu main entrance facing the metro station

items.information: Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor. Competitors will be divided into two groups. **Attending the entire competition and judging/scrambling for the group you aren't competing in is mandatory.** You may register to however many events you want, but keep in mind that the combined time limit for finishing your solves is 22 minutes. (e.g. after five 2x2 solves of 10 seconds you have 21:10 left for the remaining events) You may choose the order of the events you compete in. However, you must finish one event before starting a new one. Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija. Kilpailijat jaetaan kahteen ryhmään. **Paikallaolo koko kilpailun ajan on pakollista ja sinun täytyy tuomaroida/sekoittaa ryhmässä jossa et kilpaile.** Voit ilmoittautua kuinka moneen lajiin tahansa, mutta pidä mielessä, että kokonaisaikaraja kaikille ratkaisuille on 22 minuuttia. (esim. viiden 10 sekunnin 2x2 ratkaisun jälkeen aikaa lopuille lajeille on 21:10) Voit valita järjestyksen lajeille, joissa kilpailet. Edellinen laji pitää kuitenkin lopettaa ennen seuraavan aloittamista.

items.name: Autumn Cubing Reunion Athens A - 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBczJJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6d41a95dbcd2b6c177ccb028ad973065c128a8aa/reunion%202024.jpg) [](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcnA1IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--07e81cdd5b508271bf1d27c0c873b462bead0340/image.png) **Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το Α μέρος σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **μόνο σε έναν από τους δύο**. Ο 3x3 είναι και στους δύο διαγωνισμούς οπότε διαλέξτε με προσοχή ποια μέρα ή πoιο από τα 4x4 και Clock ή 2x2 και OH επιθυμείτε. Μετά από τις διακοπές θα βρεθούμε ξανά για τον πρώτο διαγωνισμό της νέας σεζόν! Ελάτε να περάσουμε όμορφα για ακόμα μία φορά στον γνωστό πλέον χώρο του Rubicon. Σας περιμένουμε στο **Autumn Cubing Reunion Athens 2024 - A. ** Αγωνίσματα Α' διαγωνισμού: * 3x3 * 4x4 * Clock Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) **Note:** This competition is part A of a series of two competitions. You can participate in **only one of the two**. 3x3 is in both contests so choose carefully which day or which of 4x4 and Clock or 2x2 and OH you prefer. After the holidays we will meet again for the first competition of the new season! Come and have a good time once again at the famous Rubicon venue. We are waiting for you in **Autumn Cubing Reunion Athens 2024 - A.** Competition Α events: * 3x3 * 4x4 * Clock Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: Este torneo es la séptima edición del Aventura Cúbica. Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA. REGISTRO: Se debe realizar el pago en la tienda TCG (The Cube Girls) de Lima, ubicada en Galería Brasil, Av. Brasil 1275, interior 66-A, Jesús María (http://thecubegirls.com/index.php/tiendas). Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la pestaña “Horario" (Schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la pestaña “Categorías” (Events). Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. *Los competidores que vengan de fuera de Lima deberán comunicarse y coordinar la forma de pago con el organizador, Alexander Esquivel CEL: 982527214. El registro permanecerá abierto mientras no se alcance el límite de competidores. Sin embargo, solo tendrán derecho a recibir polo quienes completen su registro (inscripción y pago) antes del 02 de febrero.

items.information: **REGISTRO** La participación en este torneo requiere de la comprensión de los siguientes requisitos: 1. El valor de la inscripción para uno o todos los eventos es de **$20.000** pesos colombianos. 2. Conocer el reglamento de la WCA ya que este es un torneo oficial. 3. Elegir los eventos a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar las pestañas Eventos y Cronograma. Prestar atención a los formatos de las rondas y a sus cortes y límites. 4. Inscribirse electrónicamente completando el proceso aquí. 5. Hacer el pago de la inscripción a la cuenta: **Nequi 3206760220** 6. Enviar comprobante de pago al **WhatsApp 3206760220** con el nombre completo del participante ya registrado en la WCA en el torneo. 7. Esperar a que el registro electrónico sea aceptado. **REGISTRATION** The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Registration fee for one or all events is **$20.000 COP** 2. Being familiar with the WCA rules since this is an official competition. 3. Carefully choosing the events. Keep in mind the rounds format, cutoffs and limits. 4. Registering online completing the process here. 5. Paying your registration to **nequi 3206760220** 6. Sending a screenshot or an image of the receipt through WhatsApp **3206760220** with the competitor’s full name after he/she is already registered on the competition website. 7. Waiting for your registration to be approved online.

Let's come to our competition to take a chance! ※3x3x3 will be 3 rounds if the number of competitors for the event is less than 100.

items.information: 11/3に行われるAyase Autumn A 2022(**本大会 / 以下、A大会**) と11/6に行われる[Ayase Autumn B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AyaseAutumnB2022) (以下、B大会) は 、WCA シリーズ大会です。 ### シリーズ大会では、そのうち１つだけに参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 なお、A大会とB大会は開催種目が異なります。ご留意ください。 **A大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (3ラウンド) / 3x3x3 目隠し / スクエア1 / スキューブ / クロック / 3x3x3複数 目隠し** B大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (3ラウンド) / 5x5x5 キューブ / 6x6x6 キューブ / メガミンクス (2ラウンド) 新型コロナウイルス感染症 (COVID-19) 対策のため、本大会では会場への入場者数を制限しています。 飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。 会場の広さの都合上、本大会の**見学申請は、競技参加者１名につき同伴者１名**に制限しています。 競技参加者１名につき２名以上の同伴や、その他**一般からの見学申請は受け付けておりません。** また、見学希望者多数の場合は未成年の同伴者など配慮を必要とする方を優先する場合があります。 ### 会場についての注意 ### 今回の会場は集会室1,2共に**靴を脱いで**利用する部屋となります。そのため、衛生上の観点から競技者及び見学者の方は**靴下の着用**をお願いします。 Ayase Autumn A 2022 (**This competition, A**) and [Ayase Autumn B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AyaseAutumnB2022) (B) are WCA Series Competitions. ### You can register either of these series competitions. If you register for multiple competitions, only the earliest one will be received, and the others will be rejected. Please make sure that the events for A and B are different. **A: 3x3x3 Cube (3 round) / 3x3x3 blindfolded / Square-1 / Skewb / Clock / 3x3x3 Multi-Blind** B: 3x3x3 Cube (3 round) / 5x5x5 Cube / 6x6x6 Cube / Megaminx (2 round) The number of persons in the venue is controlled as a COVID-19 countermeasure. **Only the companions of competitors are allowed to enter the venue as spectators.** Being mindful of space, we can only accept requests of **1 companion at MAX per competitor.** If the number of requests would become too many, a certain prioritization might be applied. (Ex. Guardians for minors) ### Attention ### In room 1 and 2, you have to take off your shoes. So, you must wear socks due to hygienic reasons.
